name: Recombined UHT Full Fat Milk
ingredients_raw: Purified Water, Cow's Milk Powder, Milk Fat, Stabilizer (E412, Guar Gum and E407, Carrageenan), Emulsifier (Vegetable origin) (E471, Mono - and diglycerides of fatty acids); Added Vitamins A (Retinyl Palmitate) and Vitamin D3. Min. 3% Milk Fat and Min. 8.25% Milk Solid Not Fat.
